compiled_state.description:
Found while verifying d724 AC10 against Windows sweep 35551741150.

tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py::test_signing_key_keeps_restrictive_mode asserts the signing key is mode 0o600. Windows reports 0o666 because it does not implement POSIX permission bits, so the assertion can never hold there.

Needs a decision rather than a mechanical fix: either the test asserts POSIX-only and is skipped on Windows, or rebar owes a real Windows ACL equivalent for signing-key confidentiality. The second reading is a genuine security question, not a test-portability one, and should be settled before the test is silenced.

Not the d724 defect class.
compiled_state.title: Signing-key mode assertion assumes POSIX permission bits
